mapping.draft_py:
# FDN Midnight Reaper: "Whenever a nontoken creature you control dies, this creature deals 1 damage
# to you and you draw a card."
# Event: a CreatureDiesEvent over your nontoken creatures (Basri's Lieutenant's "creature you
# control dies", Gadrak's FNot(IS_TOKEN) for "nontoken"); it is a leaves-the-battlefield trigger, so
# Midnight Reaper's own death triggers it too (CR 603.10a). Effect: the each-opponent damage shape
# over your own player zone (1), then M21 Dread Presence's "you draw a card".
trigger = TriggeredAbility(
    event=CreatureDiesEvent(
        filter=FAnd(
            children=(
                FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.CONTROLLER_IS, who=ControllerRef.YOU),
                FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.TYPE_EQ, string_value='Creature'),
                FNot(inner=FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.IS_TOKEN)),
            ),
        ),
    ),
    condition=None,
    effect=Seq(
        steps=(
            A(Verb.DEAL_DAMAGE, {
                'amount': QConst(value=1),
                'target': Selector(
                    count=QUnbounded(),
                    mode=SelectorMode.ALL,
                    filter=FAnd(children=()),
                    zones=(Zone(kind=ZoneKind.PLAYER, controller=ControllerRef.YOU),),
                ),
            }),
            A(Verb.DRAW, {'amount': QConst(value=1), 'controller': ControllerRef.YOU}),
        ),
    ),
)
abilities = [trigger, *compiled]

clauses.clause: Whenever a nontoken creature you control dies, this creature deals 1 damage to you and you draw a card.
